meta.name: install-and-verify
meta.description: Verify that a web app change actually works by driving the running app from the inside (DOM, network, routing, console, framework state) instead of screenshots or guessing. Use after any user-facing change, when a fix is claimed but unproven, when a test passes but the UI is broken, or when you need a real verdict rather than "looks right". Also use to install and wire up Reticle in a project that does not have it yet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动运行中的网页应用,验证改动是否真的生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改了网页却不确定它是否真的生效,又不想靠截图猜。
copy.tagline_en: Verify web changes actually work by driving the running app，not screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed a web page and need proof it really works，not a guess

howto.what: 它把 Reticle 的开发版 SDK 接进你正在运行的应用,用 reticle_* 工具直接驱动页面,验证改动是否真的生效,而不是靠截图或猜测;项目里还没有 Reticle 时,它会先安装并接好。
howto.when: 当你在面向用户的改动之后想确认它真的生效、某个修复被声称完成却未经验证,或项目还没有 Reticle 需要先安装接好时触发。

say.text: 帮我验证刚才的改动有没有真的生效
say.note: 它会驱动应用并给出 verified 结论

say.text: 跑 reticle_verify 的 change 模式,检查我改的文件
say.note: 针对具体文件做回归检查

say.text: 这个项目还没装 Reticle,帮我装好并接上
say.note: 它会跑 init、启动开发服务器并等待会话连接

howto.what_en: It wires Reticle's dev-only SDK into your running app and drives the page with reticle_* tools to check whether a change really works, instead of screenshots or guessing. If the project lacks Reticle, it installs and connects it first.
howto.when_en: Use after any user-facing change, when a fix is claimed but unproven, when a test passes but the UI is broken, or to install and connect Reticle in a project that does not have it yet.

say_en.text: Verify that my last change actually works
say_en.note: It drives the app and returns a verified verdict

say_en.text: Run reticle_verify in change mode on the files I edited
say_en.note: Checks a specific file like src/App.tsx

say_en.text: This project has no Reticle yet - install and connect it
say_en.note: It runs init, starts the dev server, waits for a session
